description: This file defines the 'Required' validation rule class used in the OrangeHRM project, specifically for validating required fields in API requests. It includes a constructor to set whether empty strings are excluded and a validate method to check input presence.

classes.name: Required
classes.description: A validation rule class used to ensure that input data is present, with options to exclude empty strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Required rule, with an option to exclude empty strings from being considered valid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check on the input, returning true if valid according to the rule.
